items.name: GA Cubers February A 2022
items.information:
This competition is part of a series competition, meaning that you can only participate in 1 competition of the series. [Please see the series tab for more information.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GACubersFebruaryA2022#17369-series-competition)

For Safety Precautions we ask that competitors and their one guest only be in the venue during the competition's scheduled time. Please do not be in the venue before or after the specific competition.
